notes.subject: גורו
notes.rationale: Lemma means 'turn aside/lodge'; versions split between 'fear' (KJV/JPS) and 'flee/shun' (Wycliffe); rendered here as 'ni siran' (fear).

notes.subject: חרב/חרב
notes.rationale: Same word חרב twice — 'sword' and 'is/brings the sword' — pun on wrath's punishments being sword-shaped; flattened in Bambara.

notes.subject: dɔ bɛ yen
notes.rationale: Hebrew שדין lacks an explicit 'there is'; Bambara requires the existential clause.

notes.subject: to Job's friends
notes.rationale: Direct plural address to the three friends warning them of judgment.

translation: Aw ni siran npan ye, sabu yen sanuya kɔnɔ, jurumuw ka npan bɛ ɲɛsin yen, walasa aw bɛ dɔn ko sariya dɔ bɛ yen.
